notes: classes[<gpu>].scales is measured fps/p95_ms at render scale 1.0/0.5/0.25.
default_class is pool (native), scaled (use default_scale) or exclude.
source=measured has scales; source=declared has none and is derived from
the tiers.tsv cost class (reason says so); source=derived-from-hd4000 is
the unmeasured HD3000 class, one notch below the measured HD4000 entry.
min_gles is the GLES version the shaders need; a class below it is exclude.
